backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: VIXY, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock leadership, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The volatility-relief leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: volatility-premium compression confirmed by SPY/QQQ relief may identify stock leaders before the next session fully reprices the risk-on move.

2_history_check.exp-20260605-033: Cross-section pressure resilience failed across all windows; this tests relief after volatility compression, not stress resilience during selloff pressure.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-004/005: Broad recent-winner continuation failed tail/drawdown; this requires explicit VIXY/SPY/QQQ relief state.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-019/020: Official macro relief stock leadership was accepted as a shared adapter; this does not retune it and uses a different cross-asset volatility state instead of event-calendar days.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-027: Macro stress resilient leadership failed with thin sample and negative EV; this tests risk relief rather than stress.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: VIXY volatility-relief days with SPY and QQQ confirmation may identify liquid stock leaders whose next-open continuation beats cash without adding noisy broad momentum.
interpretation: The volatility-relief stock-leadership source cleared Gate 4 as a replay-only/default-off lead, but no production surface was promoted.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that VIXY relief is still a broad beta/momentum relabel or arrives too late for next-open single-stock continuation after costs.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping VIXY return, VIXY close-location, SPY/QQQ relief, stock close-location, volume, ret20/ret60, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT volatility evidence, such as actual VIX term structure, options/realized-vol compression, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source produced positive replacement value in all three windows without breaching drawdown, survival, or concentration guardrails, suggesting volatility-premium compression added a distinct cross-asset risk-relief state.

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted macro relief leadership shows risk-relief stock leadership can work; pressure/stress and broad momentum neighbors often failed, so VIXY relief is plausible but low probability and must pass all three windows.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter exposing the same VIXY/SPY/QQQ volatility-relief context, sector-known liquid stock universe, stock leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
